# ServiceNow Data Model Design

Use this skill for ServiceNow data model artifacts.

## Procedure

1. Identify native tables to leverage before adding custom tables.
2. Justify every custom table.
3. Define fields, types, lengths, references, defaults, nullable rules, unique keys, indexes, and choice values.
4. Define ACL and row-level access patterns.
5. Define business rules and validation rules.
6. Define sys_properties and configuration controls.
7. Identify parked/future data additions.
8. Prepare ERD-ready relationships.

Use `templates/enterprise/servicenow-data-model.md`.

**Why?** ServiceNow data models should be native-first and governance-ready.
